entities.summary: Jukka Vilander is a former professional Finnish ice hockey forward. He is a four time Finnish champion with HC TPS and is 1996 Danish Champion with EfB Ishockey. He has made SM-liiga All-Star Team in 1988–89 season. Vilander has represented Finland men's national ice hockey team in three Ice Hockey World Championships.
